description: Recommend the right HelloBooks tier for a business. Pass `needs` (free-text phrases like "GST filing", "multi-currency", "API access", "multi-entity", "payroll"), an optional `estimatedAnnualTransactions`, and an optional `country` for local pricing. Scores the core ladder (Free → Starter → Pro → Business → Scale) against the stated needs and transaction volume and returns the LOWEST-priced eligible tier that covers the most needs, plus the full ranked breakdown with matched/unmatched needs and per-tier price. Heuristic over published feature bullets, not a quote — confirm with list_plans / list_features. Add-ons and the free Partner Program are excluded from the core ladder.

country.description: ISO country code, for local pricing. Omit for the USD/default list.

estimatedAnnualTransactions.description: Expected ledger transactions per year. Above the Free cap (200) rules out Free.

needs.description: What the business needs, as free-text phrases, e.g. ["GST filing","multi-currency","API access","multi-entity","payroll"].

name: recommend_plan
